title: The Snare-Setter's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the primers that teaches snares planted in open air and the barb that rides the tripped line.

title: A Treatise on Rune-Sowing
summary: A treatise on sowing runes of soul force that lie asleep and then bind or foul the souls that wake them.

title: The Hawk's Watching Frame
summary: Teaches holding a lattice of soul force high and quiet and dropping it on whatever steps out of line.

title: The Basin Canon of Dormant Force
summary: A canon on gathering soul force like still water and loosing it from a sleeping spring when a soul stirs it.

title: The Wind-Sworn Reckoning of Snares
summary: A reckoning of threads and snares for the wind-sworn that tighten against every pull and bend with every gust.

title: The Open Sky Snaring Manual
summary: A manual of the open tangle that stands unhidden in the air and holds every soul that wanders into it.
